assertions.evidence: The runtime applied the generated bug-fix workflow.

The root reported the isolated writer result and retained patch before integration.
The root checked the patch before applying it; an outer check confirmed exactly one changed line.
The root reran the original command after integration; exit 0 reported two passes and zero failures.

limitations: The root manually integrated the retained patch because the probe deliberately configured apply=false.
This fixture proves one bounded writer, not concurrent writers or external-system completion.
